subject: COBOL words
notes: An externalized name may be referenced as method-name in an INVOKE statement. 14.9.23.2 gives INVOKE no word form for the method at all - only literal-1 or identifier-2 - and 14.9.23.4 GR2 a) routes that literal through 8.3.2.2, so the method roster is keyed on OoMethodSymbol.ExternalizedName. The golden invokes by the AS literal and reaches the method; the declared method-name does not resolve, which is what this rule requires. kb/Work PB303.
